description_en: Retrieves the information about multiple audio and video files at a time by audio or video ID, including the title, description, duration, thumbnail URL, status, creation time, size, snapshots, category, and tags
description_zh: 调用本接口通过音/视频ID批量获取多个音视频的标题、描述、时长、封面URL、状态、创建时间、大小、截图、分类和标签等信息
name: GetVideoInfos

parameters.help_en:
The list of audio or video IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs. You can obtain the audio or video ID by using the following methods:
If the video is uploaded by using the ApsaraVideo VOD console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the audio or video ID.
Obtain the audio or video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
After the audio or video file is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID列表。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持20个。可通过以下方式获取音/视频ID：
通过控制台上传的视频，可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
音/视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of custom IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID 列表。由一个或多个自定义 ID 组成，多个 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持 20 个

NonExistReferenceIds.description_zh: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表

items.description_en: The list of custom IDs that do not exist
items.description_zh: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表

items.title_zh: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表。

NonExistReferenceIds.title_en: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表。
NonExistReferenceIds.title_zh: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表。

NonExistVideoIds.description_en: The list of audio or video IDs that do not exist

items.description_en: The list of audio or video IDs that do not exist

VideoList.description_en: The information about the audio and video files

items.description_en: The details of the audio or video file

CoverURL.description_en: The thumbnail URL of the audio or video file

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the audio or video file was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 音/视频创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the audio or video file

DownloadSwitch.description_en:
The status of the offline download switch. If the offline download feature is enabled, mobile users can cache videos to their local devices for offline viewing by using ApsaraVideo Player. For more information, see [Offline download]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86107.html）. Valid values:

on: enabled. Offline download is allowed.
off: disabled. Offline download is not allowed
DownloadSwitch.description_zh:
离线下载开关状态，打开离线下载功能后，则允许移动端用户通过阿里云播放器将视频缓存至本地观看。具体操作，请参见[离线下载]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86107.html）。取值：

on：开启，允许离线下载。
off：关闭，禁止离线下载

Duration.description_en: The duration of the audio or video file. Unit: seconds

ModificationTime.description_en: The last time when the audio or video file was updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModificationTime.description_zh: 音/视频的最后一次更新时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ReferenceId.description_en: The custom ID. The value can contain only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and must be 6 to 64 characters in length. The value is unique at the user level
ReferenceId.description_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
ReferenceId.title_en: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表。
ReferenceId.title_zh: 不存在的自定义 ID 列表。

RestoreExpiration.description_en: The expiration time of the media asset restoration

RestoreStatus.description_en:
The restoration status of the media asset. Valid values:
Processing: The media asset is being restored.
Success: The media asset is restored.
Failed: The media asset failed to be restored
RestoreStatus.description_zh:
媒资解冻状态。取值：
Processing：解冻中。
Success：解冻成功。
Failed：解冻失败

Size.description_en: The size of the audio or video source file. Unit: bytes
Size.description_zh: 音/视频源文件大小。单位：字节

Snapshots.description_en: The array of video snapshot URLs

items.description_en:
The array of video snapshot URLs.
This operation returns only the thumbnail snapshot data of the video. To query the snapshot data of normal snapshots, sprite snapshots, sprite original images, and WebVTT snapshots captured by using the [video snapshot]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99368.html） feature, call the [ListSnapshots](~~ListSnapshots~~) operation
items.description_zh:
视频截图URL数组。
本接口仅会返回视频的封面截图数据，通过[视频截图]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99368.html）功能截取的普通截图、雪碧截图、雪碧图原始图、WebVTT截图的截图数据，请调用[ListSnapshots](~~ListSnapshots~~)接口查询

Status.description_en:
The video status. Valid values:

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.
UploadFail: The video failed to be uploaded.
UploadSucc: The video has been uploaded.
Transcoding: The video is being transcoded.
TranscodeFail: The video failed to be transcoded.
Blocked: The video is blocked.
Normal: The video is in a normal state
Status.description_zh:
视频状态。取值：

Uploading：上传中。
UploadFail：上传失败。
UploadSucc：上传完成。
Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeFail：转码失败。
Blocked：屏蔽。
Normal：正常

StorageClass.description_en:
The storage class of the media asset. Valid values:
Standard: standard.
IA: media asset Infrequent Access.
Archive: media asset Archive.
ColdArchive: media asset Cold Archive.
SourceIA: source file Infrequent Access.
SourceArchive: source file Archive.
SourceColdArchive: source file Cold Archive.
Changing: the media asset storage class is being changed.
SourceChanging: the source file storage class is being changed
StorageClass.description_zh:
媒资存储类型。取值：
Standard：标准。
IA：媒资低频。
Archive：媒资归档。
ColdArchive：媒资冷归档。
SourceIA：源文件低频。
SourceArchive：源文件归档。
SourceColdArchive：源文件冷归档。
Changing：媒资存储类型变更中。
SourceChanging：源文件存储类型变更中

StorageLocation.description_en: The storage address of the audio or video file

Tags.description_en: The tags of the audio or video file. Multiple tags are separated by commas (,)
Tags.description_zh: 音/视频标签。多个标签之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔

Title.description_en: The title of the audio or video file

UserData.description_en: The custom settings. The value is a JSON string that supports settings such as message callbacks and upload acceleration. For more information, see [UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html）
UserData.description_zh: 自定义设置。为 JSON 字符串，支持消息回调、上传加速等设置。更多信息，请参见[UserData]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86952.html）
